Our newsroom is observing the evolution of AI with curiosity — and caution.

The world of artificial intelligence offers promise and peril in equal measures, which is why Civil Beat is moving into this new world cautiously. The trust of our readers is far more important to us than speed or experimentation, so we will continue to view all new AI tools with the skepticism they deserve.

For now, our use of AI begins and ends with human beings. It is limited to background tasks such as transcribing notes from audio and video, assisting with computer programming for data analysis, and scraping information from public websites.

The world of AI is changing daily. If our thinking on its use in our newsroom evolves in the future, we will update this policy.
